rubric.verified-in-use: An r3 gate seat, the r3 parent execution, or an r5 verification seat applied this item's predicate to a real target. The recorded command may differ from the checkbox example; that difference is fidelity.
rubric.never-exercised: No r3 or r5 gate applied this item's predicate. Absence of an off-record operator glance is stated as not-evidenced, not as a proof the operator never saw a table.
rubric.fidelity: exact = written command/threshold was the gate; analogue = a related check ran; absent = no check recorded.

scope_of_gates.r3_removal: The only removal r3+r5 executed: 21 worktree metadata prunes (lore 19 + gd2d 2 detached). Receipt class metadata-prune. LOG.md:132-150. Commit 36746332.

scope_of_gates.r5_removal: None. r5 verified r1-r4, patched both tools (symlink-present, pushed-unverifiable), and re-locked the 3 gd2d pins. It did not delete artifacts and did not re-apply Pre-removal as a removal precondition.

The taxonomy command `git fetch -q && git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> origin/main` was not the command re-run. items.text: Owning repo has no unpushed commits touching the artifact (`git log --not --remotes --oneline -- <path>` empty)
items.r3: Predicate applied with a sharper command. 26 round-3 seat files contain `log --branches --not --remotes --`. Examples: S63 `git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline -- .git/worktrees` → 0; S53 same form over the approval-list directory → 0 lines; S64 comm of unpushed-touched paths vs 96 SAFE paths → 0. LOG.md:132 also records a repo-global re-check: lore + gd2d unpushed = 0 at act time. lessons/round-3.md:15-18 cites this checklist item as the artifact-scoped gate.
items.r5: Not re-run as a removal gate. S05 (round 5) used `git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline | wc -l` on the fleet root, not the path-scoped checklist form.
items.drift: The written command string has one hit in the lane: SKILL.md:76 only. It omits --branches, so it would miss unpushed commits not reachable from HEAD. It also cannot see untracked .git/worktrees admin dirs (S23: ls-files .git → 0), so it would not have withheld the 3 gd2d pins. The gate that withheld them is not in this checklist: `git log --oneline <branch> --not --remotes` (tool evaluate_worktree, souji-verify.sh:321).

items.text: Owning repo worktree is clean over the artifact (`git status --porcelain -- <path>` empty)
items.r3: Exact command recorded in 4 round-3 seats: S23 and S25 on `.git/worktrees/<name>` (empty, and non-informative because .git is untracked); S53 claims it empty for approval-list rows that were not deleted; S50 on MANIFEST.json/LOG.md/SCORECARD.md, not a removal target. The executed targets' checkout dirs were absent, so path-scoped status could not be taken there (round-3 S05 dirty_check: impossible).
items.r5: S05 ran `git status --porcelain -- .ufo/waves/round-14/registry-home/context.md` during a verdict audit of a file that was not removed. S44 ran it on tools/souji-verify.sh. Neither was a removal gate.
items.drift: Installed tools do not implement the path-scoped form. evaluate_repo_root uses repo-global `git status --porcelain` (souji-verify.sh:305). evaluate_worktree uses `git -C "$target" status --porcelain` only when the dir is present (souji-verify.sh:341), which is the case the r3 prune explicitly did not have. Absent dir short-circuits to metadata-prune.

items.text: Entry is in a dry-run table the operator has seen, unless receipt is `pushed` and quarantine hold elapsed
items.r3: A dry-run listing existed (S62: `git worktree prune --dry-run -v` named exactly the 19 lore registrations). No lane record shows that listing, or the 21-set, was a table the operator had seen before the parent pruned. The exception clause does not cover the removal: receipt was metadata-prune, not pushed, and no quarantine hold elapsed. The 96 pushed rows, which the exception could have covered, were not removed. LOG.md:147: the approval list awaits operator sign-off.
items.r5: S28 recorded `find /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin -type d -name .ufo-quarantine -print` → no matching paths, find_exit=0. r5 did not start a hold and did not remove the approval-list rows.
items.uncertainty: This seat did not search operator chat outside the lane. 'Operator has seen' is not evidenced in LOG.md, .ufo/reports/round-3/souji.md, or the r3 gate seats. That is not a proof no off-record glance happened.

items.text: Nothing references the artifact (`rg -l` across owning repo, 0 hits)
items.r3: S58 prune authorization included a live-pin sweep: `rg -l --no-ignore --hidden -F <name>` with census/tests excluded, hits classified historical, live_gate_or_fixture_pin=0. 34 round-3 seat files mention `rg -l`. The literal '0 hits' rule was not the gate: historical prose hits were allowed.
items.r5: Not a removal gate. S51/final-57 reproduced a false-SAFE: installed `rg -l` omits --hidden, so a scratch file referenced only from a hidden path still verifies SAFE(stale). That defect is not in the three r5 material fixes (symlink-present, pushed-unverifiable, logs_tier existence). Current tools still lack --hidden.
items.drift: Checklist says unqualified `rg -l` and 0 hits. r3 gate added --hidden --no-ignore -F plus exclusions and a historical-hit exception. Installed count_live_refs (souji-verify.sh:205, souji-vault-verify.sh:435) is `rg -l --no-ignore --fixed-strings` with census/tests/quarantine globs and no --hidden.
